_comment: Default seed data and configuration defaults for Email MFA V2. HostBill modules in the Other/ directory ship a default.json next to the main class so admins can drop in a different file to override defaults at install time. Email MFA V2 has no lookup-table data to seed (codes are transient and stored in hb_email_mfa_codes at runtime), so this file only carries the configuration-defaults map used by the install/upgrade flow.
